title: 形状是怎么拼起来的
subtitle: 三角形、方块和圆
character: wearing a yellow t-shirt, blue shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in cut-paper collage style, flat geometric shapes with clean straight edges, bright mustard, teal, coral and cream on plain paper, simple and graphic, the illustration covers the entire image area

pages.zh:
我把积木倒在地板上。
有方的，有圆的，
还有尖尖的。
我想把它们拼成一座房子，
可是总有地方空着。
pages.scene: The little boy sits on the floor among wooden blocks of different shapes, holding one triangular block, thinking.

pages.zh:
先认认它们。
三条边的是「三角形」，
四条边一样长的是正方形，
四条边两长两短的是长方形，
一条边都没有的是圆。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: four shapes in a row on a cream background: a triangle, a square, a rectangle and a circle. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
三角形最结实。
三根棍子搭成一个三角，
捏住怎么推都不变形。
四根棍子搭成方块，
一推就歪了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two shapes made of sticks on a cream background: a triangle staying firm, and a square leaning over to one side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以桥上、
房顶里、
塔的架子上，
藏着很多三角形。
它们在替我们扛着重量。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple bridge on a cream background made of straight beams forming a row of triangles. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
正方形最会铺。
一块挨一块，
不留缝，也不重叠，
能把整块地面铺满。
瓷砖就是这么铺的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one flat area on a cream background completely filled with equal squares in neat rows, leaving no gaps. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
三角形和六边形
也能铺满。
可是圆不行——
圆挨着圆，
中间总会留下小空隙。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two patches side by side on a cream background: the left one filled with touching hexagons and no gaps, the right one filled with circles that leave small gaps between them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
圆最会滚。
圆的边上每一点
到中心的距离都一样，
所以滚起来不上不下，
车坐着才稳。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two carts side by side on a cream background: the left with round wheels rolling level, the right with square wheels tipped up and down. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
形状还能对折。
沿着一条线折过去，
两半刚好盖住，
那条线就叫对称轴。
蝴蝶、叶子都是这样。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one butterfly shape on a cream background with one straight dashed line down the middle and arrows showing the two halves folding together. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
把大形状切开，
能得到小形状。
一个正方形斜着切一刀，
就变成两个三角形；
两个三角形也能拼回去。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one square on a cream background with a diagonal line across it, and beside it the same two triangles moved apart. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
站起来的形状叫立体。
球会滚，
正方体能摞得很高，
圆柱躺着滚、立着稳，
圆锥尖尖的，只能立着。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: four solid shapes in a row on a cream background: a ball, a cube, a cylinder and a cone. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以搭积木有诀窍：
底下用方的，
中间用长的，
屋顶用三角的。
下面稳，上面就不倒。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one simple tower on a cream background: a wide square base, two long rectangles above it and a triangle on top. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把方块放在最下面，
三角形放在最上面。
房子搭好了，
一推也不倒。
原来每个形状，都有自己的本事。
pages.scene: The little boy kneels beside a finished block house with a triangular roof, both hands raised, proud and happy.
